title: AI-Driven Healthcare Diagnostics
abstract: Developing explainable AI models to assist radiologists in detecting early signs of neurodegenerative diseases from MRI scans. The project involves high-dimensional image processing and implementing deep learning architectures.

title: Secure IoT Communication Protocols
abstract: Investigating lightweight encryption standards for low-power IoT devices in smart home environments. Focus on energy efficiency and resistance to side-channel attacks.

title: Blockchain for Supply Chain Transparency
abstract: Building a decentralized application (DApp) to track pharmaceutical supply chains to prevent counterfeit drugs. Requires knowledge of smart contracts and consensus algorithms.
